item.title: LSMSA to Host Exploration Day for Prospective Students and Families on October 12 (2026-10-05)
item.description: School's faculty recently named No. 1 in the nation by Niche.com NATCHITOCHES, LA. The Louisiana School for Math, Science, and the Arts (LSMSA) will host an Exploration Day on Monday, October 12, 2026, from 8:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Prospective students and their families are invited to tour the campus, meet current students, faculty, and staff, and experience LSMSA's living-learning environment.
